title: An identical command retry replays before any staging lookup

stage.reason: stage TTL expired and the abandoned-stage retention removed the directory

steps.action: deduplication lookup by requestId in the retry record map (commands.md 6.1 step 2)

expect.outcome: recorded result found and digest equal

observations: the expired staging handle is never consulted: the authoritative command is stage-free (content-storage.md 6.1) and its request digest is computed over request bytes only
no blob publication and no envelope write occur
a composition that resolves a stage before issuing the command must first rule out a replay via the same pure retry-map read

notes: commands.md §6.1 step 2 (dedup) precedes §6.1 step 5 (validation, where a stage handle is resolved). An implementation that resolves the stage before dedup breaks lost-ack retry.
